Standing alone on a stage, looking out at hundreds of empty seats, is perhaps one of the loneliest feelings in the world.🥹
Loneliest? Or a little exciting too? There is nervousness, anticipation… and a heart beating a little faster.❤️‍🩹
In another half an hour, these seats will fill with people, their voices, their laughter, their lives. And this lonely man will become part of a shared experience. The magic of theatre will begin.🎭🎭
But for now, there is this silence. And so much going on inside me.
Raleigh, we are about to perform #JaanePehchaaneAnjane for you! Tomorrow we travel to New York for our show on October 4.
An empty auditorium. But A thousand possibilities. Jai Ho! ❤️🎭 #Theatre #Live #Audience

Captain Smit Machchhar, extraordinary courage and presence of mind when it mattered most.

You helped avert a disaster and save lives. Wishing you a speedy recovery.
